#WorldCancerDay is close to my heart. As a two-time breast cancer survivor, I am so grateful for the lifesaving work of all those who support patients & survivors.

To those still fighting: I send you my love. #IAmAndIWill

Everyone deserves access to the medications they need. I’m proud to cosponsor the #SafeStepAct to remove barriers patients face when seeking help.

Congress now has the chance to put health care decisions back in the hands of patients and their doctors. #SSADayOfAction

Happy #NationalDogDay to my favorite workmate, Harley!

(We love you, even if you tend to sleep on the job) 😉 🐶 https://t.co/PJ1fIQnHyL

Our work to end gun violence will not end until parents no longer fear their children's safety at school, worshippers can exercise their religion without armed security, and mass shootings are not viewed as the norm in this country. Our fight continues.

Twice, I was told I had breast cancer. Twice, my family and friends felt the impact of my diagnosis. Twice, because of the support of my doctors and loved ones, I survived.

Cancer impacts the lives of every single American. Together, we can end cancer as we know it.

Affordable, reliable health care coverage is now available at https://t.co/0KFSMnIf2Y. This year, 3.2 million Americans found plans for less than $10 a month!

You have until December 15 to enroll in a plan that starts at the beginning of 2023. Be sure to #GetCovered. #ACA https://t.co/J2iGNsjPZr

Today, #WorldCancerDay, hits close to home for me. 

I'm a two-time breast cancer survivor, and I feel so much gratitude for all those who support patients and survivors. To all those fighting—I’m in awe of your powerful spirit and I send my love. #IAmAndIWill https://t.co/bYyhtuai6q

Step therapy can cause harm & slow the recovery of patients while frustrating doctors simply trying to care for their patients.

We've introduced the #SafeStepAct to reaffirm the value of the doctor-patient relationship & move toward the best form of patient-centered care.
We must always fight to put people first, and this legislation will help ensure doctors and patients can make the best possible health care decisions. #SafeStepAct

Ten years ago, the Shelby County ruling opened the floodgates to voting discrimination with an intensity that has only continued.

Voting rights protect all other rights, and today we fight on to protect and exercise the fundamental right to vote. #ShelbyAt10 https://t.co/wFiIpSgSSp

In July of 1965, the original form of Medicare was signed into law and set up an avenue for older Americans to have affordable, quality health care coverage.

Are you or someone you know newly eligible? Sign up or learn more at https://t.co/3YaTfq7h1q.

Self care is necessary, important, and looks different for everyone. One of my favorite practices is prayer.

On this International Self Care Day, take time to connect with loved ones, go outside, rest, or exercise. For additional resources, visit https://t.co/xEHEFXl2kW
NEW: Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act we passed last year, Medicare is now able to negotiate for lower drug costs for 10 common drugs, saving Americans thousands. https://t.co/XkvzQstTNs

Learn more about these prescription drugs and what this announcement means for your family⬇️
https://t.co/mddHr3uQ3T

I was proud to support the Inflation Reduction Act and help ensure our seniors can get the medication they need.

Thanks to the $35 monthly cap on insulin that I led, 2,700 Medicare beneficiaries in #GA07 are saving more than $450 a year on their insulin. https://t.co/i4WHwlH57V

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth.

As a two-time survivor, I remember how scary it was to first learn of my diagnosis. Join me in honoring survivors, researchers, doctors, caregivers, those fighting, and those we've lost.

You are in my heart. 🩷

As a two-time breast cancer survivor, I know just how critical immediate access to care is following a diagnosis. That's why I am a proud cosponsor of @RepGarbarino & @USRepKCastor's #MetastaticBreastCancerAccesstoCareAct, which will waive Medicare and SSDI waiting periods.

During #ACA Open Enrollment, affordable, reliable health care coverage is available at https://t.co/DxoSqcN0ge.

You can help your loved ones get signed up starting TODAY through December 15. Plans begin January 2024. https://t.co/QQVbuUQJnO

It's critical we all take time to look after our health and wellbeing. During Open Enrollment, you can select quality, affordable health insurance plans for you and your family.

Visit https://t.co/JgpicSPFAb today and sign up by December 15th for plans starting in 2024! https://t.co/XgrtzMGqhO

On #WorldAIDSDay, we honor the memories of those we have lost and recommit ourselves to research, treatment, and support for those affected by the HIV epidemic.

Bipartisan efforts like the Ending the HIV Epidemic Initiative show that we can work together to make a difference.

I currently lead a bill in Congress to expand eligibility for WIC in the postpartum and breastfeeding periods, improving health outcomes and advancing equity nationwide.

These nutrition guidelines are an important step in helping provide peace of mind.
https://t.co/xKu9EpncqD

#Juneteenth is a day to celebrate freedom. A freedom hard earned and fiercely defended.

The foundation of that freedom is our democracy and the power to voice our views through voting.

In Congress, we fight to make sure every American is able to exercise that right.

Veterans have sacrificed so much for our nation, and we must live up to the promises we make to service members and veterans when it comes to their hard-earned benefits.

That is why I was honored to help Aaron access the health care treatment he needs. https://t.co/miFlCIGYyN

As a two-time breast cancer survivor, I know how crucial it is to be a champion for affordable health care. 

That's why I was proud to assist Cecilia's Medicare application process. https://t.co/hhWM3FWQaP
